When I arrived noticed it wasn’t just a small camera shop felt more like a distribution hub.. several workers constantly moving in and out carrying bags and products that made me more confident this place actually deals in authentic gear.I decided to buy an Osmo Nano, which is hard to come by elsewhere. Paid online through their site and picked up the product at the shop. They gave me a paper invoice and assured warranty is genuine and handled through them, which was a relief because warranty can be tricky with rare items.So far, everything’s been smooth. Will update this review if I face any issues with warranty claims, but for now Design Info seems like a trustworthy place for rare camera gear and more.If you’re curious about hard-to-find camera equipment, it’s worth a visit to verify for yourself like I did.
